title: Concessive Balance: Jóllehet, Bár... Mégis & Ennek dacára

sections.title: Concessive Structures
sections.content: Concessive balance weighs an acknowledged drawback against a triumphant conclusion: *jóllehet* (although, albeit), *bár... mégis* (although... nevertheless), and *ennek dacára* (in spite of this).

items.spanish: Jóllehet sok időbe telt, sikerült befejezni a kutatást.
items.english: Although it took much time, we succeeded in finishing the research.

items.spanish: Bár a feladat rendkívül nehéz volt, mégis helytálltak a munkatársak.
items.english: Although the task was exceptionally difficult, the coworkers nevertheless stood their ground.

items.spanish: Minden akadálynak dacára elértük a kitűzött célt.
items.english: In spite of all obstacles, we reached the set goal.
